title: Hearty Flaky Croatian Lamb Skillet
description: A pungent and flaky one-pot Croatian dish featuring canned tomatoes and lamb, made in a cast-iron skillet. This recipe is low-glycemic-friendly and perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the katsuramuki-cut lamb shoulder to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Roll out the phyllo dough and use it to cover the skillet, brushing with a little water to seal.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
